notes.title: REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER FEST 2024
notes.content:
It's that time of the year again, that's right- political discourse season. No not really, well probably, who knows.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938438/f3a6660c5d288dc641d317c685a7041d23df967c.png[/img]
Nah, we're talking about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay_together]STEAM'S REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER FEST[/url]!! What that means is, BKPC is currently on sale, so you can finally buy it for roughly its original full price!

The benefit of this though, is you can PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS using Steam's nifty feature that allows you to remotely play together, using one single copy of the game. 

For anyone unsure how to even DO Remote Play Together, it's super simple and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay#together]Steam even made a simple guide[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625830/Brendan_Keoghs_Putting_Challenge/

If you've already purchased, played and enjoyed BKPC (thank you), but make sure you leave a positive review telling everyone just how dumb and good this game is. You'd be surprised how beneficial they are.

Happy Remote Playing Together!

- Paper House ːwombatloveː

notes.title: BKPC Is Actually On Sale This Time
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938438/0030670379c7c9e0d298abd3d46cbcf67f92309d.png[/img]

We did it. We managed to not mess up the Steam backend and actually make the game on sale. Yeah we know it's probably similar to whatever the previous price was, but you know what they say- [i]"A bird in the hand is worth two in the bush". [/i]

Not entirely sure what it means, but it feels like a golfing term? It has birdies and bushes. Either way BKPC is on sale at the moment and that includes the OST and the Golf Buggy DLC.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625830/Brendan_Keoghs_Putting_Challenge/

You can play this game online with [b]Steam Remote Play Together [/b]as well. It's surprisingly easy to use and also means you only need one copy of the game to play with all your mates.

[previewyoutube=Dxz_sZ-TEX0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you've picked up the game and have enjoyed it, please leave a positive review. Brendan made this game all by himself and he's not even a real programmer, so it will make him really happy.

We should also point out that this game was essentially self published too, so any purchase of the game goes directly to supporting Brendan and us! (Paper House) Sure Gabe gets a cut, but that's capitalism babey!

- Paper House xo

notes.title: BKPC is on "Sale" for MIGW23
notes.content:
It's the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/migw2023]Melbourne International Games Week Steam Event[/url][/b]! It's a fantastic event which showcases a bunch of locally made games and features demos, sales and broadcasts!

[b]To celebrate, Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge will be "on sale"* [/b]for the new price of $5.99 USD, [b]which is roughly a 15% increase![/b] If you act now you can pay even more than previously!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938438/bb005a137033a7b55eb334134a5a9a45f4c8511d.png[/img]
Yes, clearly something is going on here. Valve recently changed the rules around the cost of games and the minimum for sales. BKPC fell well well below that threshold so we've updated the cost to reflect these changes, but that also meant we weren't allowed to officially discount the game. Ha Ha Whoops!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625830/Brendan_Keoghs_Putting_Challenge/

We'll be putting the game on discount in the future, so don't worry about that (when we're allowed). Also! if you've already purchased it, thanks for the support! You've now got it at a limited edition cost.

Anyway, that's capitalism babey.

- Paper House

notes.title: Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge - One Year Anniversary!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41938438/4c26112073eab40e20ae9d990f5c780b81f38eca.png[/img]

One year ago today, the biggest game of 2022 was released. A game that included a massive environment, a thrilling yet ambiguous story, and an ambitious approach to multiplayer interaction.
 
That game was [i][b]Elden Ring.[/b][/i]
 
On the same day, I released [i]Brendan Keogh’s Putting Challenge[/i], [b]which also turns one year old today![/b]

⛳️ ⛳️ [b]To celebrate such a successful first year, the game is on sale for the next week![/b] ⛳️ ⛳️
🏌🏿🏌🏻‍♀️[b]Perfect time to buy a copy for your friend, or to finally treat yourself to that golf cart DLC![/b] 🏌️‍♀️🏌🏼‍♂️
 
This was my first ever commercially released game, and I made it in my spare time around a full time job. The reception has been really incredible and humbling, and it’s been so wonderful to see people actually playing and enjoying the game!
 
[u]Here’s a few exciting things that happened in the game’s first year:[/u]
-   	[i]Kotaku Australia[/i] crowned us as [url=https://www.kotaku.com.au/2022/12/the-best-aussie-games-of-2022/]one of the best Australian games of 2022[/url].  
-   	The crew from [i]Sifter[/i] [url=https://www.sifter.com.au/post/just-like-real-golf-brendan-keoghs-putting-challenge-is-all-about-taking-time-and-chatting-with-your-mates]played a round of golf and chatted to me about the game.[/url]
-   	The game was exhibited at [url=https://twitter.com/darthtayrah/status/1578017764924542978]Massive Monster’s Freeplay Parallels afterparty.[/url]
-      The game was part of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/group/41054038/view/3266822573484513036]Melbourne International Game Week's Steam showcase[/url]. 
-   	The game was exhibited at Game On 423 at the Brisbane Powerhouse, [url=https://twitter.com/GEastmead/status/1626243252801179648]where I also did this little interview.[/url]
-   	People actually bought the game!
-   	My brother who doesn’t play videogames very often 100%’ed all the achievements.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1625830/Brendan_Keoghs_Putting_Challenge/
 
Thank you again for all of your support! It’s been an absolutely incredible experience both making and then releasing this game.
 
[i][b]If you've already picked up my game (and think it's neat) please leave a positive review, it's really helpful and I love reading what people enjoy.
[/b][/i]
Finally, a very special thank you to Terry at my publisher, Paper House. It’s no exaggeration to say this game probably wouldn’t have happened without him, and it certainly wouldn’t have been the success it was. While you’re here, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677010/Wood__Weather/]you should go check out and wishlist Paper House’s new game.[/url]

- Brendan Keogh

notes.title: Game Update: Minor Bug Fixes + Screenshot functionality added - 2 March 2022
notes.content:
Thank you everyone who has played [b][i]Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge[/i][/b] so far! The response to my tiny game has been really wonderful and I really appreciate it.

I have fixed a few small bugs that people have found in this update. Mostly tiny ones related to specific achievements and secret holes

Most importantly, I have[b] added functionality for taking screenshots with the Steam overlay[/b] (F12 by default, usually). So please show us your amazing scores and near misses!

Thank you again for your support! If you have been enjoying the game, please consider leaving a review! It really helps. 

Happy golfing!
Brendan

notes.title: Remote Play Together 2022!
notes.content:
[i]Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge[/i] is joining a huge list of discounted games which celebrate the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/remoteplay_together][b]Remote Play Together Sale[/b][/url] on Steam!

Invite up to three of your mates using Remote Play and you have complete freedom to explore the massive open-world at your own pace with your friends. Play a round of mini-golf, compete on a full 9 hole course, go for a bike ride or just see who can hit the ball the furthest at the driving range.

[*]That's it!

Oh also, the Luxury Golf Cart has four seats! ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge - Released on Steam!
notes.content:
[h3]Brendan Keogh's Putting Challenge is now currently live on Steam! 
You can play it right now! 10% launch discount![/h3]

BKPC is a relaxing open-world golf game about all the parts other golf videogames cut out. Sounds tedious? It sort of is. 

With up to four players on a single device (or online by using Remote Play), you have complete freedom to explore the massive open-world at your own pace with your friends. Play a round of mini-golf, compete on a full 9 hole course, go for a bike ride or just see who can hit the ball the furthest at the driving range. It’s entirely up to you!

Thank you again to Paper House and everyone who helped me get this game together. See you on the greens! (or bunker)
- Brendan
